detail.command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p WeatherFlow/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset
cat > /tmp/make_weatherflow_icon.swift <<'SWIFT'
import AppKit

let W = 1024, H = 1024
let rep = NSBitmapImageRep(bitmapDataPlanes: nil, pixelsWide: W, pixelsHigh: H, bitsPerSample: 8, samplesPerPixel: 3, hasAlpha: false, isPlanar: false, colorSpaceName: .deviceRGB, bytesPerRow: 0, bitsPerPixel: 0)!
let ctx = NSGraphicsContext(bitmapImageRep: rep)!
NSGraphicsContext.saveGraphicsState()
NSGraphicsContext.current = ctx
ctx.shouldAntialias = true
let canvas = NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: W, height: H)
NSGradient(colors: [NSColor(calibratedRed: 0.08, green: 0.48, blue: 0.98, alpha: 1), NSColor(calibratedRed: 0.02, green: 0.23, blue: 0.72, alpha: 1)])!.draw(in: canvas, angle: -42)

// Soft atmospheric glow
let glow = NSBezierPath(ovalIn: NSRect(x: 505, y: 475, width: 470, height: 470))
NSColor(calibratedRed: 0.35, green: 0.78, blue: 1.0, alpha: 0.12).setFill(); glow.fill()

// Sun and rays
let sun = NSPoint(x: 700, y: 705)
NSColor(calibratedRed: 1.0, green: 0.78, blue: 0.08, alpha: 1).setStroke()
for i in 0..<8 {
  let a = Double(i) * .pi / 4
  let r1 = 128.0, r2 = 178.0
  let p = NSBezierPath()
  p.lineWidth = 26; p.lineCapStyle = .round
  p.move(to: NSPoint(x: sun.x + cos(a)*r1, y: sun.y + sin(a)*r1))
  p.line(to: NSPoint(x: sun.x + cos(a)*r2, y: sun.y + sin(a)*r2))
  p.stroke()
}
NSColor(calibratedRed: 1.0, green: 0.78, blue: 0.08, alpha: 1).setFill()
NSBezierPath(ovalIn: NSRect(x: 590, y: 595, width: 220, height: 220)).fill()

// Cloud shadow
NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.0, alpha: 0.12).setFill()
NSBezierPath(roundedRect: NSRect(x: 190, y: 300, width: 650, height: 240), xRadius: 120, yRadius: 120).fill()
NSBezierPath(ovalIn: NSRect(x: 245, y: 410, width: 275, height: 275)).fill()
NSBezierPath(ovalIn: NSRect(x: 430, y: 470, width: 320, height: 320)).fill()

// Cloud
NSColor(calibratedWhite: 1.0, alpha: 1).setFill()
NSBezierPath(roundedRect: NSRect(x: 170, y: 325, width: 650, height: 240), xRadius: 120, yRadius: 120).fill()
NSBezierPath(ovalIn: NSRect(x: 230, y: 430, width: 285, height: 285)).fill()
NSBezierPath(ovalIn: NSRect(x: 420, y: 490, width: 330, height: 330)).fill()
NSBezierPath(ovalIn: NSRect(x: 585, y: 420, width: 255, height: 255)).fill()

// Flow accent: three subtle cyan streaks under cloud
NSColor(calibratedRed: 0.55, green: 0.88, blue: 1.0, alpha: 0.9).setStroke()
for (y, inset) in [(265.0, 0.0), (218.0, 58.0), (171.0, 116.0)] {
  let p = NSBezierPath(); p.lineWidth = 18; p.lineCapStyle = .round
  p.move(to: NSPoint(x: 310 + inset, y: y)); p.curve(to: NSPoint(x: 720 - inset, y: y), controlPoint1: NSPoint(x: 430 + inset, y: y + 18), controlPoint2: NSPoint(x: 600 - inset, y: y - 18)); p.stroke()
}
NSGraphicsContext.restoreGraphicsState()
let png = rep.representation(using: .png, properties: [:])!
try png.write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: "WeatherFlow/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon.png"))
SWIFT
swift /tmp/make_weatherflow_icon.swift
cat > WeatherFlow/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/Contents.json <<'JSON'
{
  "images" : [
    {
      "filename" : "AppIcon.png",
      "idiom" : "universal",
      "platform" : "ios",
      "size" : "1024x1024"
    }
  ],
  "info" : { "author" : "xcode", "version" : 1 }
}
JSON
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('project.yml')
s=p.read_text()
needle="        SUPPORTS_MACCATALYST: NO\n"
if 'ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME' not in s:
    s=s.replace(needle, needle+"        ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME: AppIcon\n")
p.write_text(s)
PY
xcodegen generate
file WeatherFlow/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon.png
sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight -g hasAlpha WeatherFlow/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon.png
echo '=== STATUS ==='; git status --short
